blocks.explanation:
Is sawal mein tangent wali term \(3\tan x\) ek seedhi line \(2x + 1\) ke barabar hai. Aisi equation bhi algebra se exact hal nahi hoti, is liye graph ka tareeqa.
Diya kya hai? Equation aur interval \(-\frac{\pi}{2}\) se \(\frac{\pi}{2}\).
Find kya karna hai? Woh \(x\) jahan \(y = 3\tan x\) aur \(y = 2x + 1\) milte hain.
Plan: asymptotes pehchanein, table banayein, graph kheenchein, crossing parhein, pakka karein aur check karein.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(3\tan x = 2x + 1\), \(x \in \left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\).
Maloom karna: interval ke saare roots.
Tareeqa: \(y = 3\tan x\) aur \(y = 2x + 1\) ko ek hi axes par plot karenge aur intersection parhenge. Madad ke liye farq \(d = 3\tan x - (2x + 1)\) ka sign dekhenge.

Har graph ki shakal
\(y = 3\tan x\) origin se guzarta hai aur hamesha barhta rehta hai. \(x = \pm\frac{\pi}{2}\) par is ki vertical asymptotes hain, yani woh khari lines jin ke qareeb graph bohat ooper ya bohat neeche chala jata hai magar unhein chhoota nahi, kyunke wahan \(\tan x\) undefined hai. Is liye kinare wale points khud root nahi ho sakte; hum andar \(-\frac{\pi}{2} < x < \frac{\pi}{2}\) dekhenge.
\(y = 2x + 1\): slope 2 aur y-intercept 1 wali line; \(-2.14\) se \(4.14\) tak.
Kyun: Bayen kinare ke qareeb tangent curve line se bohat neeche hai aur dayen kinare ke qareeb bohat ooper. Jo cheez neeche se ooper jaye, woh beech mein kam az kam ek dafa line ko zaroor kaategi.

Table of values (radians, 2 decimal)
\(x = -1.5\): \(3\tan x = -42.30\), \(2x + 1 = -2\), \(d = -40.30\)
\(x = -1\): \(-4.67\), \(-1\), \(d = -3.67\)
\(x = -0.5\): \(-1.64\), \(0\), \(d = -1.64\)
\(x = 0\): \(0\), \(1\), \(d = -1\)
\(x = 0.5\): \(1.64\), \(2\), \(d = -0.36\)
\(x = 1\): \(4.67\), \(3\), \(d = 1.67\)
\(x = 1.5\): \(42.30\), \(4\), \(d = 38.30\)
Kyun: \(d\) ka sign sirf ek dafa badalta hai, 0.5 aur 1 ke darmiyan. Is ki wajah bhi samajh lein: \(3\tan x\) ka slope \(3\sec^2 x\) hai jo kabhi 3 se kam nahi hota, jab ke line ka slope sirf 2 hai. Yani tangent curve hamesha line se tez charhta hai, \(d\) barhta hi rehta hai aur sirf ek dafa zero ho sakta hai.
Dhyan dein: \(x = \pm 1.5\) par values bohat bari hain; graph par sirf woh hissa banayein jo page par aaye.

Graph bana kar intersection parhein
Figure mein line tangent ki branch ko sirf ek jagah kaat'ti hai:
\[x \approx 0.66\]
Kyun: Ek intersection point ka matlab ek root.

2 decimal tak pakka karein
\(d(0.655) = -0.006\), \(d(0.665) = +0.022\)
Kyun: 0.655 aur 0.665 par sign mukhtalif hain, is liye root (asal mein \(0.6570\ldots\)) inhi ke beech hai aur round ho kar 0.66 banta hai.

Tasdeeq
\(x = 0.66\): \(3\tan 0.66 = 2.328\)
\(2(0.66) + 1 = 2.320\)
Kyun: Dono sides takreeban 0.01 tak barabar hain, to jawab sahi hai.
blocks.final_answer:
\(x \approx 0.66\) radians
Yani is interval mein sirf ek root hai.

answer_figure.alt: Graph of y = 3 tan x (blue, one increasing branch through the origin between the dashed vertical asymptotes x = minus pi/2 and x = pi/2) and the line y = 2x + 1 (pink). They meet once, at x about 0.66, marked with a dashed line to the x-axis.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key mein \(x = 0.65\) radians likha hai. Root asal mein \(x = 0.6570\ldots\) hai (\(d(0.655) = -0.006\), \(d(0.665) = +0.022\)), jo round ho kar \(0.66\) banta hai. \(x = 0.65\) par dono sides \(2.281\) aur \(2.300\) hain, barabar nahi. Sahi jawab: \(x \approx 0.66\) radians.
